parameters.axis: Chooses the horizontal or vertical axis.
parameters.fraction: first's share, when the caller holds it.
parameters.initialFraction: first's share to begin with, when the widget holds it.
parameters.onChanged: Told the new share as the rule moves.
parameters.minSecond: The minimum extent of the second pane.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls the rule.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
parameters.minFirst: The minimum extent of the first pane.
